title: SIMATIC ET 200SP
summary: Fine-granular distributed I/O system: an interface module plus BaseUnits with plugged I/O modules, usually connected over PROFINET.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: An ET 200SP station consists of an interface module (for example a PROFINET IM), BaseUnits that carry the wiring and the potential groups, and electronic I/O modules plugged onto them. Light-colored BaseUnits open a new potential group and feed the load voltage.

sections.heading: Typical faults
sections.body: A missing load voltage on a potential group, a module plugged on the wrong BaseUnit type or a configuration that differs from the installed modules are reported by the IM and appear in the CPU diagnostics.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: PLC Lab does not simulate PROFINET. ET 200SP concepts (potential groups, configured versus installed modules) are represented by the generic rack model. **CONCEPTUAL** only.
